main: A face no one has seen.
slides.sub: The most critically acclaimed music of this century was made by a man nobody knows.

quote: Only five people in the world
slides.note: Burial. 2007. South London. First signed to Hyperdub. Told no one.

slides.sub: Field recordings. Rain. City noise. Vinyl crackle laid over the top. One room. Not a studio.

text: they look like a fish skeleton.
slides.sub: He never learned the correct way. That is why the sound was entirely his.
Urban loneliness as music. A landmark in electronic music history.

text: He worked with all of them.
slides.sub: The Independent printed his name in 2008. He stayed silent.

text: Every one of them says it:
slides.sub: No four-on-the-floor. No BPM race. Just the night. The loneliness that stayed hidden reached the most people.

slides.strobe: The city's loneliness, made into sound, became the most heard silence of the century.
